title: How can we prevent food shortages?
questions: What are the main ideas you learned from this episode? Please give a brief summary in your own words.
What do you think is the biggest cause of food shortages: conflict, climate, poverty, waste, or weak distribution systems?
Should countries try to produce more of their own food even if imported food is cheaper?
How much food security can be improved simply by reducing waste?
Who should receive priority when a serious shortage occurs?
If you controlled a limited budget, would you invest first in farming technology, storage, transport, or emergency food reserves?
